title: DataTable
description: Data-driven Fiori table from TanStack Table column definitions: sorting via header menu or click, selection, popin, growing and row virtualization.

usage.summary: Render data-driven responsive tables with TanStack columns, sorting and optional row virtualization.
useWhen: Let users sort and compare flat business records through data-driven columns.
Use virtualization when roughly 200 loaded rows of average complexity would be exceeded; rethink the design above 1,000 rows rather than mounting them all.
Filter data in the caller before passing results; this wrapper supplies column sorting, not built-in column-filter editors.
Supply data and columns, stable getRowId for selection, and virtualize with fixed rowHeight and virtualHeight when rendering only visible rows.

avoidWhen.when: Compare wide analytical datasets with resizable, reorderable or frozen columns.
Compose JSX rows and cells without data-driven sorting, keeping roughly 200 loaded rows of average complexity and rethinking the design above 1,000.
Browse a few attributes per item or read chronological object events without aligned column comparison.
Expand and collapse a parent-child hierarchy; this wrapper renders flat rows.
Inspect or edit fields of one object rather than compare repeated records.
